name: ComingSooner
author: achakaj

sections.description:
ComingSooner is a lightweight and customizable plugin that lets you easily create stunning Coming Soon and Maintenance Mode pages for your website. Packed with powerful features to keep your visitors informed while you build or maintain your site.

Key Features

🎨 Design & Customization

  • Custom logo and background image upload
  • Background color picker
  • Custom page title and description
  • Built-in Coming Soon and Maintenance Mode templates
  • Elementor template support — use your own Elementor-designed pages

⏱️ Countdown Timer & Progress Bar

  • Countdown timer with customizable target date
  • Launch progress bar with percentage and custom label

📱 Social Media Integration

  • Add links to Facebook, Twitter/X, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube
  • Icons display automatically — empty links are hidden

🔍 SEO Controls

  • Custom SEO page title and meta description
  • Block search engines with noindex/nofollow
  • Choose HTTP status code (503 or 200)

🔒 Access Control

  • Bypass by user role — choose which roles can see the live site
  • IP address whitelist — allow specific IPs to bypass
  • Page exclusions with wildcard support (e.g., /api/*)
  • Secret access URL — share a private link to bypass the coming soon page
  • Smart bypass for admin, AJAX, REST API, login, and feed pages

📅 Scheduled Maintenance

  • Set a start and end date/time to automatically enable and disable maintenance mode

📧 Email Subscribers

  • Built-in “Notify Me” subscription form
  • Subscriber management with bulk delete
  • Export subscribers to CSV

📊 Analytics Dashboard

  • Track total visits and daily visits
  • View total subscribers count
  • See when the last visitor accessed your page
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/coming-sooner directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings → ComingSooner to configure your Coming Soon page.
